title: 03. After Move 5: Midgame Awareness (26k–22k)
description: Bridge the gap past the opening: respond to aggressive invasions, claim open territory, and avoid chasing strong groups.

puzzles.title: Punishing an Aggressive Attachment
puzzles.prompt: Move 6: You own C3 and E5. White aggressively attaches right against your C3 stone at D3. Stand up solid to protect your corner!

solutions.feedback: Textbook Hane/Extend! Standing up at C4 keeps your C3 stone connected toward your E5 center stone while securing the left side.
Strong! Pressing at D4 uses your E5 ally to surround White's aggressive D3 stone.

wrongHints.default: When the opponent touches your stone directly, respond locally! Extend upward at C4 or press on top at D4 to link with E5.

puzzles.title: Big Empty Side vs. Small Endgame
puzzles.prompt: Move 7: Both corners on the top are settled, while the entire bottom half of the board is wide open. Claim the biggest remaining territory!

solutions.feedback: Big-picture awareness! While the top is crowded, C3 stakes out the entire open bottom-left quadrant in a single move.
Big-picture awareness! G3 claims the wide-open bottom-right quadrant while the top is already contested.
Good! E3 stakes out the open bottom 3rd line where the largest points remain.

wrongHints.default: Stop adding stones to the crowded top area—look at the empty bottom half of the board and claim a 3-3 corner (C3 or G3)!

puzzles.title: 2-Step Corner Defense
puzzles.prompt: White invades your corner at B3 while you hold C4 and E4. Block White's escape along the side!

steps.feedback: Good block at B4! White pushes into C3 trying to make a base. Now seal the bottom exit!
Sealed! D3 connects with your C4-E4 wall and traps White's B3-C3 stones inside a cramped corner with minimal eye space.

wrongHints.default: Keep White trapped in the corner: block above at B4 first, then seal the right side at D3.

puzzles.title: Turn Influence Into Territory
puzzles.concept: A central wall (thickness) only scores points when you plant a stone on the open side it faces.
puzzles.prompt: You built a strong central wall (D5-E5-E6) while White sits in the corners (C3, G7). Expand your right-side framework!

solutions.feedback: Great framework! G4 works together with your E5-E6 wall to enclose the right side and bottom-right.
Strong! F3 anchors the bottom-right and links up with your central E5 wall.

wrongHints.default: Your central wall faces the wide-open right/bottom-right quadrant—plant a stone at G4 or F3 to turn influence into territory.

puzzles.title: Rescue Your Pinned Side Group
puzzles.concept: When a group is pinned against the edge without eyes, extend along the 3rd line to gain liberties and base space.
puzzles.prompt: Your two stones at G4-G5 are pinned against the right edge by White (F4, F5, G6). Extend to gain breathing room!

solutions.feedback: Solid downward extension! G3 increases your chain liberties from 3 to 5 and opens a path toward the bottom-right corner.
Good eye-making shape! H4 secures 2nd-line base room along the right edge.

wrongHints.default: Your G4-G5 stones are blocked above at G6 and left at F4-F5—extend downward to G3 to gain liberties!

puzzles.title: Split Two Weak Enemy Stones
puzzles.concept: When the opponent leaves two stones separated across a side without a base, drive a wedge between them so they cannot connect.
puzzles.prompt: White has isolated stones at C6 and G6 with no base. Play the splitting point in the middle!

solutions.feedback: Clean split! E6 separates C6 and G6 while linking naturally with your D4-F4 stones below.
Strong central cap! E5 keeps both White stones separated and under pressure.

wrongHints.default: Drive straight up the middle between C6 and G6 (play E6 or E5) so White cannot connect across the top.

puzzles.title: SGF Lesson: Protect Your Wall's Base Before Small Edge Moves
puzzles.concept: When an opponent's stones (H3, F2) threaten to cut underneath a large central-right group (F3-F4-G4-H4), defend that cutting base immediately—a 12-point group survival is always bigger than a 2-point corner push.
puzzles.prompt: Your 4-stone group (F3, F4, G4, H4) is threatened from below by White's H3 and F2 stones. Block White's cut at G2 before your group gets surrounded!

solutions.feedback: Saved! G2 connects F3 underneath and splits White's F2 and H3 stones apart—your entire right-side wall stays alive with easy base room!

wrongHints.default: Look at the open 2nd-line gap at G2 between F3 and H3—if White plays G2, your entire F3-H4 group loses its base and gets captured!
